battle.name: 馬科曼尼-阿米尼烏斯戰爭
battle.theater: 波希米亞森林與易北河上游
battle.brief: 公元十七年，客魯西人領袖阿米尼烏斯聯合紹西人等部族攻打馬科曼尼王馬羅波杜斯，會戰未分勝負；次年馬羅波杜斯退入波希米亞森林，十九年被流亡歸國的卡圖阿爾達取代，倉皇逃往義大利。戰記未載攻城器械，卡面投石機代表的是羅馬圍城技術本身：它讓「攻下來」變成不必攻的威懾。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 交戰一方是馬羅波杜斯為王的馬科曼尼聯盟：夸迪人、蘇伊比人及其附屬村社，控制今日波希米亞森林、易北河與奧得河上游之間的廣大林地，自公元六年起被羅馬確認為「盟邦王」國，羅馬以王號、兵器與人馬維持它的地位。另一方是阿米尼烏斯率領的客魯西人，並聯合紹西人、安西格里瓦里人等日耳曼部族，兵鋒指向馬羅波杜斯的林地王國。第三方是羅馬帝國本身：駐上日耳曼的總督奧盧斯·凱基納奉提比略之命率軍進抵易北河，名義上是保護盟友，實際上也在提比略對阿米尼烏斯失去信任之際趁機干預。戰事還牽涉一位日耳曼流亡貴族卡圖阿爾達，他在古通人部落之中棲身數年，公元十九年回到祖國推翻馬羅波杜斯。三方的指揮系統性質不同：馬科曼尼一方以王居與林地要塞為核心，客魯西一方靠首領的個人威望與血緣紐帶維繫聯盟，羅馬則以行省的軍團體系為骨架，並以客戶王作為代理人。
countriesEn: One side was the Marcomannic confederation under the king Maroboduus: the Quadi, the Suebi and the village communities attached to them, holding the great woodlands between the Bohemian forest, the upper Elbe and the upper Otava; from AD 6 they were recognised by Rome as a foederate kingdom, and Rome kept that kingdom in place with the royal title, arms and men. The other side was the Cherusci led by Arminius, joined by the Chauci, the Ansigrivarii and other Germanic peoples, pressing against Maroboduus's woodland realm. The third party was the Roman Empire itself: Aulus Caecina, governor of Germania Superior, was ordered by Tiberius to march to the Elbe, ostensibly to protect the Roman allies, but in practice to intervene at the very moment when Rome's trust in Arminius had collapsed. The war also involved a Germanic exile, the noble Catualda, who lived for some years among the Gutones and came home to his country in AD 19 to overthrow Maroboduus. The three command systems were of different kinds: the Marcomannic side was organised around a royal seat and forest strongholds, the Cheruscan coalition was held together by the personal authority and the blood ties of its chiefs, and the Roman side was framed by the provincial system of legions, with client kings used as proxies.
people: 留下姓名的主要有五人。馬羅波杜斯是馬科曼尼人的王，早年受阿格里帕扶植，公元六年前後由奧古斯都確認其王號；他與阿米尼烏斯之間曾有瓦魯斯首級的轉手，維利烏斯·帕特庫爾庫斯記他將首級轉呈奧古斯都，此舉贏得羅馬的信任，也由此埋下他與北方另一個王阿米尼烏斯之間的嫌隙。阿米尼烏斯是客魯西人的領袖，公元九年於條頓堡森林重創瓦魯斯，被塔西陀稱為「德意志的解放者」；公元十一、二年間羅馬廢黜塞吉蒙杜斯、轉而立他為客魯西人的王，卻同時要他與馬羅波杜斯相安無事，他對這套安排並無好感。公元十七年戰爭爆發時，提比略懷疑阿米尼烏斯煽動查蒂人越過易北河襲擊羅馬邊境，又私下與敵人締約；他與敵人來往的嫌疑，成為羅馬立場轉變的關鍵。卡圖阿爾達是馬科曼尼貴族，因事流亡古通人部落，公元十九年回國奪位，迫使馬羅波杜斯逃亡義大利。記錄者方面，塔西陀《編年史》卷二第四十四至四十六章記述那場會戰，第六十二、六十三章記述卡圖阿爾達與馬羅波杜斯之死；維利烏斯·帕特庫爾庫斯的《羅馬史綱》則留下較為樂觀的官方敘述。
peopleEn: Five names matter most. Maroboduus was king of the Marcomanni, raised by Agrippa and confirmed as a king by Augustus around AD 6; there was an exchange over the head of Varus between him and Arminius, and Velleius Paterculus records that he forwarded the head to Augustus, which won him Roman trust and at the same time planted the seed of his rivalry with the other northern king, Arminius. Arminius was the leader of the Cherusci, who crushed Varus in the Teutoburg forest in AD 9 and whom Tacitus calls the deliverer of Germany; when Rome deposed Segimundus and installed him as king of the Cherusci in AD 11 or 12, it also required him to live in peace with Maroboduus, and he cared little for that arrangement. When the war broke out in AD 17, Tiberius suspected Arminius of having stirred up the Chatti to raid the Roman frontier beyond the Elbe and of having made a private treaty with the enemy; the suspicion of collusion became the turning point in the Roman position. Catualda was a Marcomannic noble who had gone into exile among the Gutones and returned in AD 19 to seize the throne, driving Maroboduus to flee to Italy. As for the record: Tacitus's Annals, book 2, chapters 44 to 46, describes the battle, and chapters 62 and 63 the rise of Catualda and the death of Maroboduus, while Velleius Paterculus's Compendium of Roman History preserves a more sanguine official version of the same events.
kits: 卡面這件投石機是希臘化世界在公元前三世紀中期以後成熟的扭力式石砲，維特魯維烏斯《建築十書》第十卷留有它的圖式與尺寸：巨大的木製機架、預緊的扭索束、以槓桿釋放的拋臂，拋出的不是箭而是石彈，單發便能在城牆上砸出一個破口；操作要靠人畜絞盤與拉索，需要整個工兵組配合。必須說明的是，公元十七年這場波希米亞的戰爭本身並沒有留下投石機參戰的記載：塔西陀的敘述裡完全沒有提到攻城器械，客魯西聯軍是靠封鎖、圍困與分化王國境內的附屬部族取勝的，沒有正面攻破過任何城寨。因此這件兵器在此代表的是羅馬的圍城能力本身——客戶王體系之所以能同時維持一個森林王國與一個河畔王國，靠的正是可以把「攻堅」變成「工程」的技術與人馬。就戰場上實際用到的兵器而言，日耳曼各方配備相近：長柄矛、投槍、圓盾或木盾、短劍與戰斧，投石手用皮兜繫石，騎兵在森林邊緣快速掠襲；羅馬方面的軍團步兵以方形大盾與短劍為核心，輔助部隊攜弓與標槍，投石手在萊茵河與多瑙河戰線上大量使用布底投石索。營地與運輸依靠牛車與帳車，圍城時則以撞槌、雲梯與繩梯接近城牆。
kitsEn: The onager on the card is a torsion stone-thrower of the kind that the Hellenistic world had perfected by the middle of the third century BC, and Vitruvius's tenth book of De architectura preserves its diagram and dimensions: a huge timber frame, skeins of sinew wound tight in advance, a throwing arm released by a lever, hurling a stone rather than an arrow, and a single shot capable of opening a breach in a wall; it was worked by human and animal capstan, and required a whole engineering team to serve it. It must be said plainly that no record of the onager in the Bohemian war of AD 17 has survived: Tacitus mentions no siege engine at all, and the Cheruscan coalition won by blockade, encirclement and the detachment of the subject communities inside the kingdom, never by storming a single settlement. The weapon therefore stands here for the Roman capacity for siege as such, for the client-king system could hold a forest kingdom and a river kingdom at once only because it could turn assault into engineering. As for the arms actually carried in the field, the Germanic sides were similarly equipped: long thrusting spears, javelins, round or wooden shields, short swords and axes, slingers using stone balls held in leather cups, and horsemen who raided the edges of the forest at speed; on the Roman side the legionary infantry fought around the large square shield and short sword, the auxiliaries carried bows and pila, and slingers with cloth-bottomed slings were numerous on the Rhine and Danube fronts. Camp and supply rested on ox carts and wagons, and sieges were approached with rams, ladders and rope.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術，核心是森林與河谷。馬羅波杜斯的王國沒有連續的城牆，而是以王居所在的林地要塞為中心，憑藉河道、沼澤與密林自守；客魯西聯軍不與他在開闊地決鬥，而是把兵力壓進河谷通道，斷其聯絡、迫其分兵，再對孤立的寨子逐一圍困。公元十七年的會戰因此打成不分勝負的消耗戰，次年馬羅波杜斯退入波希米亞山林，把防禦縱深拉到極限。羅馬軍隊在同一條戰線上的做法有制度可循：縱隊自萊茵河下游基地北進，每日推進約二十公里上下，抵達易北河後先設營固守，營地依羅馬式野戰營制逐日築牆掘壕，並在營外派騎巡邏；遠程投射兵器與攻城器材，要等到外圍抵抗被解除之後才展開。羅馬人對付森林也有一套成熟辦法：砍出林道、逐段清林，把游擊戰的地利一件件剝走。塔西陀對這場戰爭的戰鬥過程著墨極少，上述陣形與攻城細節多由同時期的羅馬制度與同一區線的其他戰役推得，不能當作本場戰爭的直接記錄。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this war were a matter of forest and river valley. Maroboduus's kingdom had no continuous wall, but a royal seat in a woodland stronghold defended by rivers, marshes and dense trees; the Cheruscan coalition did not meet him in the open, but pushed columns into the river corridors, cut his communications, forced him to divide his forces, and then invested the isolated strongholds one by one. The battle of AD 17 accordingly turned into an indecisive war of attrition, and in the following year Maroboduus withdrew into the mountains of Bohemia, stretching his depth of defence to the limit. The Roman army on the same line followed a system: columns set out from the bases on the lower Rhine, advancing on the order of twenty kilometres a day, established a fortified camp on reaching the Elbe, and raised the ditch and rampart of the Roman marching camp day by day while cavalry patrolled outside; bolt throwers and siege equipment were brought forward only once the outer resistance had been removed. Rome also had a settled answer to the forest: cutting tracks and clearing the wood section by section, stripping away the ground that favoured the irregular war. Tacitus says almost nothing about how this particular war was fought; the deployment described above is drawn from the Roman military system of the same age and from other campaigns on the same line, and cannot be treated as a direct record of these operations.
data: 可核對的數字集中在年份與距離上。開戰在公元十七年，次年馬羅波杜斯退入波希米亞山林，公元十九年卡圖阿爾達返國取代他；被廢之王逃往義大利後，提比略把他安置在拉文納，軟禁十八年，公元三十七年死於流放地。文本出處是塔西陀《編年史》卷二第四十四至四十六章與第六十二、六十三章，以及維利烏斯·帕特庫爾庫斯《羅馬史綱》第二卷第一百零九與第一百一十九節。卡西烏斯·狄奧記載羅軍自萊茵河行軍至易北河約需二十三日，是關於縱隊推進速度最具體的一個數字。距離上，由易北河上游至萊茵河下游的直線距離約六百公里，羅軍須在敵境內推進數百公里。兵力方面，兩支部耳曼聯盟的數目都沒有留下可靠記錄，只能確定上日耳曼方面駐有數個軍團及大量輔助部隊，塔西陀並提到有營級輔助部隊在戰線上遭到屠殺、另有士兵逃亡。投石機這邊，維特魯維烏斯留下了機架與扭索的尺寸記載，現代復原實測的有效射程多在百數公尺到二百公尺上下，拋出的石彈重可達數十公斤，單發破壞集中於牆面一小片。至於月份，史籍完全沒有記載，此處填五月，只是按易北河流域春末夏初河水可涉、林道泥濘難行而林地易守的作戰季節所作的推測，並非史料所載。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around dates and distances. The war opened in AD 17; in the next year Maroboduus withdrew into the mountains of Bohemia; in AD 19 Catualda returned and displaced him. The deposed king fled to Italy, where Tiberius settled him at Ravenna and kept him under detention for eighteen years, and he died there in AD 37. The textual sources are Tacitus, Annals, book 2, chapters 44 to 46 and 62 to 63, and Velleius Paterculus, Compendium of Roman History, book 2, sections 109 and 119. Cassius Dio records that the march of the Roman army from the Rhine to the Elbe took about twenty-three days, and that is the most concrete figure we have for the pace of a column. As for distance, the straight line from the upper Elbe to the lower Rhine is roughly six hundred kilometres, and the Roman army had to push several hundred kilometres through enemy country. On numbers of men, no reliable count survives for either of the two Germanic coalitions; what can be established is that several legions and a great many auxiliaries were stationed in Germania Superior, and that Tacitus mentions cohort-sized auxiliary units being massacred on that front and soldiers deserting. For the onager, Vitruvius preserves the dimensions of the frame and the torsion skeins, and modern reconstructions put its effective range in the neighbourhood of a hundred to two hundred metres, with a stone of several tens of kilograms, and a single shot concentrating its damage on one small patch of wall. As for the month, the sources are simply silent; May is entered here only as an inference from the campaigning season of the late spring and early summer, when the Elbe could be forded and the muddy forest tracks slowed movement, and is not a fact of the record.
cause: 打起來的理由可以分幾層。最外的一層是羅馬的客戶王體制：馬羅波杜斯與阿米尼烏斯都是羅馬扶植的王，卻分屬兩支部族聯盟，羅馬希望他們彼此牽制，而不是誰吃掉誰；這套安排要求阿米尼烏斯容忍一個比他強大的北方鄰國，而馬羅波杜斯也須維持自己在羅馬眼中的「有用」與「安分」。第二層是馬羅波杜斯的擴張：他控制夸迪與蘇伊比，把勢力推過易北河上游，並要求羅馬承認他對周邊日耳曼部族的宗主地位；羅馬擔心自己的代理人坐大，一旦日耳曼各部在他的統合下形成一個足以單獨與羅馬抗衡的勢力，萊茵河與多瑙河兩端的平衡就會被打破。第三層是阿米尼烏斯的不滿：他既被羅馬立為客魯西人的王、又被要求與馬羅波杜斯共存，部族中的威望又因條頓堡森林而壓過所有其他首領，這種雙重身分使他在客魯西人內部屢遭反對，在羅馬方面也屢受懷疑；公元十六年以來關於他煽動查蒂人越境、與敵人私訂條約的傳聞，正出現在這個節點上。直接導火線則是公元十七年客魯西人、紹西人與其他聯軍對馬科曼尼人的大舉進攻，戰爭自此由暗流變成明戰。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting can be read at several depths. The outermost is the Roman system of client kings: Maroboduus and Arminius were both kings raised by Rome, but they belonged to two different tribal coalitions, and Rome wanted them to check each other rather than for one to swallow the other. The arrangement required Arminius to tolerate a northern neighbour stronger than himself, while Maroboduus had to remain useful and docile in Roman eyes. The second layer is Maroboduus's own expansion: he held the Quadi and the Suebi, pushed his power across the upper Elbe, and pressed Rome to acknowledge his overlordship over the neighbouring Germanic peoples; Rome feared that an agent of its own might grow too large, and that if the German tribes were drawn together under his leadership they could face Rome as a single power, which would unbalance both the Rhine and the Danube. The third layer is Arminius's own discontent: Rome had made him king of the Cherusci and simultaneously required him to live alongside Maroboduus, while the authority he had won at Teutoburg placed him above every other chief in his own people's eyes; that double position left him opposed within the Cherusci and suspect in Rome. The reports that from AD 16 he was stirring up the Chatti to cross the frontier and making private arrangements with the enemy belong to this moment. The direct spark was the great attack in AD 17 by the Cherusci, the Chauci and their allies on the Marcomanni, which turned a slow current of hostility into open war.
impact: 影響最深的一層，是羅馬日耳曼政策的轉向。此前的做法是讓客戶王彼此消耗，公元十七年之後羅馬發現單靠代理人不夠用，必須由總督親率大軍抵達易北河插手；同時它開始在同一區域不斷更換代理人，卡圖阿爾達取代馬羅波杜斯，隨後維比利烏斯又推翻卡圖阿爾達，萬尼烏斯接著以羅馬客戶王的身份統治波希米亞，直到公元五十年萬尼烏斯的兩個姪子萬吉奧與西多奪位，羅馬才直接插手這塊土地。第二是馬羅波杜斯的遭遇成為羅馬羈縻外國君主的先例：一位被自己保護過的國王流亡義大利、軟禁於拉文納十八年而終老異鄉，此後數百年的羅馬政策裡，這種「收留而不歸還」的做法一直可行。第三是阿米尼烏斯的身後名聲：他被懷疑通敵，最終在自己人的刀下死去——他之死並沒有給羅馬帶來安寧，客魯西人反而迅速分裂，安西格里瓦里人於同年再度起兵，公元二十一至二十二年羅馬不得不再次出兵。在更長的記憶裡，他成了德意志民族傳說中最有力的形象之一，公元十九世紀的德國史學把他描繪為「德意志自由的象徵」，條頓堡森林從此成為日耳曼民族主義的核心場景。最後是馬科曼尼王國的崩解所留下的空白，這片森林王國先後被扶植了三個羅馬代理人，隨後落入長期爭奪，最終導向六世紀的大摩拉維亞。
impactEn: The deepest consequence was a turning point in Roman German policy. The old method was to let client kings wear each other down; after AD 17 Rome found that proxies alone were not enough and had to intervene with a governor's army at the Elbe itself, while it began to replace its agents repeatedly in the same region: Catualda displaced Maroboduus, Vibilius in turn displaced Catualda, and Vannius then ruled Bohemia as a Roman client king until the sons of Vannius' own family, Vangio and Sido, seized the throne in AD 50, after which Rome ruled the country directly. Second, the fate of Maroboduus became the precedent for holding foreign monarchs in Roman custody: a king whom Rome had protected fled to Italy and died after eighteen years of detention at Ravenna, and for centuries afterwards the Roman policy of sheltering without returning remained workable. Third is the posthumous reputation of Arminius: suspected of collusion, he was finally killed by his own people, and his death brought Rome no peace at all, for the Cherusci split and the Ansigrivarii rose in the same year, forcing Rome to campaign again in AD 21 and 22. In the longer memory he became one of the most powerful figures of Germanic legend, and nineteenth-century German historiography presented him as the emblem of German freedom, with the Teutoburg forest becoming the central scene of German nationalism. Last is the vacuum left by the collapse of the Marcomannic kingdom: that woodland realm passed through three Roman-backed rulers in turn, fell into a long contest, and in the end led to the Great Moravia of the sixth century.
result: 結果可以分短期與長期兩層。短期看，公元十七年的會戰沒有分出勝負，十八年馬羅波杜斯退入波希米亞山林，十九年卡圖阿爾達回到祖國奪走王位，馬羅波杜斯丟下王國逃往義大利，被提比略安置於拉文納，公元三十七年死在那裡；與此同時，阿米尼烏斯在十九年被自己的部族首領刺殺，客魯西人的聯盟隨之瓦解。整場戰爭沒有留下戰俘數字、戰利品清單或佔領城池的記載，它是一場森林裡的消耗與背叛，勝負不是由會戰決定，而是由「誰能守住森林的縱深」與「誰能守住羅馬的信任」決定。長期看，馬科曼尼王國的框架崩解，波希米亞進入羅馬直接干預與代理人輪替的時代，羅馬在萊茵河與多瑙河之間的防線也從此固定為「萊茵河—易北河—多瑙河」的縱深體系。對卡面上這件投石機而言，這場戰爭留下的是一個特別的位置：戰記裡沒有它發射的痕跡，只有森林、河流與沒完沒了的圍困；羅馬的圍城器械在這條邊境上真正的角色，是讓「攻下來」變成不必攻的威懾，讓馬羅波杜斯最終選擇流亡而不是死守——它所代表的攻城技術，成為帝國外交的工具。
resultEn: The result divides into a short term and a long term. In the short term, the battle of AD 17 decided nothing; in AD 18 Maroboduus withdrew into the mountains of Bohemia; in AD 19 Catualda came home and took the throne, and Maroboduus left his kingdom behind and fled to Italy, where Tiberius settled him at Ravenna and he died there in AD 37; at the same time Arminius was murdered in AD 19 by the chiefs of his own people, and the Cheruscan coalition fell apart. The war left no list of prisoners, no catalogue of booty, no account of towns taken: it was an exhaustion and a treachery fought inside the forests, and its outcome was not decided by a battle but by two things, who could hold the depth of the forest and who could hold the trust of Rome. In the long term the framework of the Marcomannic kingdom collapsed, Bohemia entered an age of direct Roman intervention and of agents put in and thrown out in turn, and the Roman line on this front settled into the deep system of the Rhine, the Elbe and the Danube. For the onager on the card this war leaves a peculiar place: the record contains no trace of its firing, only forests, rivers and endless blockade. The real role of the Roman siege engine on this frontier was to make storming unnecessary, and to turn Maroboduus's last choice into flight rather than a last stand; the siege technology it stands for became an instrument of imperial diplomacy.
